observations: Photo 0-1: front view of a large monocrystalline, half-cut-cell solar panel, mounted on a white aluminium frame, glare across cells obscuring micro-crack inspection
Photo 1 shows at least two more panels stacked behind the one in focus, suggesting multiple units for sale
Photo 2-3: rear view of a panel, white backsheet, junction box with two MC4-style connectors, a small rectangular specification sticker present but text too small/blurred to read
Watermark 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' / 'POSTED ON JIJI' is the seller's own branding stamp, not a manufacturer mark on the product
No visible wattage, brand, or model number legible on panel frame or sticker in any photo
Background shows an open-air shop/warehouse setting with bags and cables, consistent with a solar equipment dealer

claims.claim: Seller states 'We deal...' (message cut off, implying they deal in solar equipment)
claims.evidence: Text is incomplete and is a business description, not a verifiable product claim

claims.claim: Implied claim of new/unused panel (clean frame, no visible wear)
claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show no dirt or scratches but no purchase receipt, box, or manufacturer seal is shown

risks.risk: Actual wattage/spec unknown, which is the primary price driver for solar panels
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the rear specification sticker showing model, wattage (Wp), Voc/Isc values
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without this data; treat as unknown-spec panel

risks.risk: Hidden micro-cracks or cell damage under glare
risks.proof: Photo taken in shade or with electroluminescence/flash test showing full cell surface without glare

risks.risk: Panel may be used/refurbished rather than new despite clean appearance
risks.proof: Photo of original packaging, invoice, or manufacturer seal/date code

risks.risk: Number of panels actually included in the sale is unclear (multiple units visible in background)
risks.proof: Seller statement with photo showing all units laid out and counted, or confirmation of single-unit listing
Video of panel connected to a multimeter/charge controller showing voltage/current under sunlight
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified working, i.e. worst case

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up photo of the rear specification label showing brand, model number, and wattage (Wp)
A photo or short video of the panel tested with a multimeter/charge controller showing actual voltage and current output
Confirmation of exact quantity included in this listing with all units shown together
Any original packaging, invoice, or date code proving new condition
response.reason: The item is identifiable only as a generic monocrystalline solar panel; without a readable wattage/model label, which is the key price determinant for solar panels, not even a worst-case price can be set.
